window: Past 24 hours. Search indexes were thin for US federal and military coverage; only verifiable items are included.

stories.headline: New York State Police recover about 5.5 kg of suspected fentanyl after a night-time chase from East Fishkill to Putnam County
stories.summary: Troopers tried to stop a vehicle on the Taconic State Parkway around 10:48 p.m. on October 19; the chase ran onto Interstate 84 and ended in Southeast, Putnam County.

stories.headline: Colombian Navy seizes 1.6 tonnes of cocaine on a Chocó beach, tied by the president to the Clan del Golfo
stories.summary: The Pacific naval force, backed by naval intelligence, recovered 1,645 kilos of cocaine at Playa Octavia in Juradó, Chocó.

stories.headline: Nicaraguan army intercepts about half a tonne of cocaine in sacks just off Managua's coast
stories.summary: Naval forces and national police, under Operation Dignidad Nacional, stopped a boat roughly 100 metres off Playa Salamina in Villa El Carmen, finding 18 sacks holding 450 packages…

stories.headline: Gujarat crime branches seize heroin and mephedrone worth about Rs 25 crore on the Ahmedabad-Vadodara Expressway
stories.summary: Joint Surat and Ahmedabad crime-branch teams stopped suspects near the CTM toll plaza, recovering 4.53 kg of heroin and 2.49 kg of mephedrone.
